label: ability: I can do it
note: CLOSED by chapter 74 -- see ML-A1-JOIN-09, which the same chapter closes. The note was right that kazhiyum and the -aan kazhiyum frame were both absent. ABILITY ARRIVES AT YOU IN MALAYALAM RATHER THAN BEING DONE BY YOU, and the track had already taught that shape: ML-C32-ariyuka's own warm-up says knowing ARRIVED at you, so the I left the subject slot. 'enikku vaayikkaan kazhiyum' is literally 'reading is possible to me', with the person in the dative exactly as the knowing sentence has it. So the ability frame costs one word and no new machinery: enikku was already held, the -aan form arrives two lessons earlier in the same chapter, and kazhiyum is the only genuinely new piece. The note said three Spanish points about ability and competence were open on this one missing form.
